strategies.name: A_boundary_polling
strategies.description: poll every head, evaluate on the fast path, confirm on a fork, then send
assumptions: latency: head poll + fast path + fork gate drawn log-normal from measured median/p90
window: one block (0.25 s) for publicly observable events; the measured lead for predictable events

bid chosen from the observed winning-bid grid to maximise expected profit over in-scope events (extra gas above the median bid charged at 565,190 units, ETH 4000 USD); P(win) = F(bid)^4 over observed winning bids
profit per captured event = Phase 3 simulated net profit with complete costs; events without one contribute 0
predictable events are multiplied by the measured share still open at the reveal block (0 when unmeasured and reported as such)
